recipeSelection.sameRecipeBehavior: when oldRecipe exists and RecipeID is unchanged, no ReLoadRecipe call is made; machine config is saved and BackgroundThreadService.ActivateSingleTaskExecute runs after the dialog.
recipeSelection.nullOldRecipeBehavior: when oldRecipe is null, ReLoadRecipe is called after saving the selected RecipeID.
recipeSelection.conclusion: Recipe selection persistence and domain reconstruction are conditional on the RecipeID comparison.

reconstruction.offlineBranch: sets PrInitSuccess=true and returns after InitProgramNodes; VmSolution close/create and PR entity loading are skipped.
reconstruction.onlineBranch: closes the existing VmSolution, creates a solution, loads current-recipe PREntity procedures, calls LoadDispensePr, then sets PrInitSuccess=true.
reconstruction.failureBoundary: catch shows an initialization message, logs, and rethrows; finally hides the tip and re-enables the UI.
reconstruction.sideEffect: WaferSystemProgram.InitWaferSystemProgram clears wafer-sub memory before resetting its singleton; the clear mode depends on IsClearStaticAdapter.

productionStart.transportPreparation: TransportDomain.StartTask initializes TransportModule, performs carrier precheck in production mode, maps material, optionally starts loader/unloader tasks, then starts TransportTask.
productionStart.conclusion: Domain reconstruction precedes production start, while transport has an additional carrier/map phase before its worker starts.

runtimeBoundary.reason: This audit reads source and hashes the original files only. It does not call the recipe dialog, ReLoadRecipe, VmSolution, Machine.Start, TransportModule, SQL, UI continuation, or hardware/device APIs.

boundaries: Static source evidence does not prove the same-RecipeID path is reachable under every UI configuration or that third-party events fire in a particular order.
It does not prove PR procedure loading, repository contents, task scheduling, signal timing, or production success.
No production source, project file, SQL, VM, hardware, device, or deployment was modified or invoked.
